summary: Computes a ride-height delta and writes a small output vector. The output first dword (a2) is zeroed, the fourth float slot (a2 + 8) is set to the track Y coordinate this[0x74C], and the second slot (a2 + 4) is overwritten with the average pitch component (this[0x3688] - this[0x3708] + this[0x3590] - this[0x3610]) * 0.5. Returns the output pointer a2.

local_names.this[0x74C]: track Y coordinate (per existing analysis, coordinatesInTrack.y)

operations.description: Zero the first dword of the output vector (a2).
Copy track Y coordinate this[0x74C] into output slot a2 + 8.

Write average ride height delta to output slot a2 + 4: (this[0x3688] - this[0x3708] + this[0x3590] - this[0x3610]) * 0.5. The source first writes a 0 dword to a2 + 4, which is immediately overwritten by this float result (dead store).
Return the output vector pointer a2.

unresolved: Global flt_59E450 (0x0059E450) is listed in the packet globals but is absent from the raw source text; its role in this function is unresolved.
Per-corner mapping of the four ride-height offsets (front/rear/left/right) is not proven by raw source; names come from existing analysis prose.
The initial 0 dword write to a2 + 4 is a dead store produced by the decompiler ordering.
